title: Recruiter ghosting
description:
Why do recruiters ghost after interviews? 

Welcome to The Job Search Circus!

Today, we tackle the most frustrating part of job hunting: recruiter ghosting.

From unanswered follow-up emails to disappearing after five rounds of interviews, we’re diving into the chaotic reality of the job search process.

#JobSearch #RecruiterGhosting #JobSeekers #JobSeekerTips
